variants.prompt: Hazel's porcelain skin is on full display as she strides confidently across a yacht's deck, the warm Mediterranean sun glinting off her glistening, oiled skin. She wears only a barely-there bikini, its emerald green hues matching her striking eyes. The bikini bottoms are cut high, barely covering her derriere, while the halter top leaves her toned midriff bare. A delicate gold chain adorns her neck, and a pair of oversized, glamorous sunglasses perch on her platinum blonde hair. A DSLR, set to shallow focus, zeroes in on her taut, sun-kissed physique as she moves towards the camera.
